name: icon-ai

layers.notes: The icon at rest: a flower of six petals with a burst of rays, in a black glass disc.
The same, dimmed (use where the feature is off, for example in a home row).
The planet: the whole disc is a globe with dotted continents.

loops.notes: flower -> planet: the flower turns and folds into a point with a flash, the planet grows out of the point with a little overshoot. Play it BACKWARDS (frame 23 down to 0) for planet -> flower. Frame 0 is exactly flower.png, frame 23 exactly planet.png.

The planet resting: the globe rocks slowly (about 20 degrees of rotation, smooth, 24 frames per second) and comes back to where it started (first and last frames are planet.png). Play once over 2 s. It used to be 12 frames at 6 fps, which looked jerky.

disc.notes: The disc is 60 pt across inside the 80 pt picture; the rest is room for the soft glow.

tapped.notes: Taps during the sequence are ignored. Total 4 s.

reduceMotion.notes: No sequence: cross-fade flower -> planet over 0.3 s, hold 2 s, cross-fade back.

notes: Icon of the 'Нейросети' step and row. The flower is an original mark (a rosette and a burst); it is not a copy of any company logo. The globe is made up (noise continents), not a map. The small halo above it is drawn by the app as for the other steps. Files: 75 PNG, 1053 KB; in memory 75 x 0.1 MB = 7.5 MB.
